title: Your first LAN
summary: Connect a workstation to a small local network and verify communication.
description: PC-02 is already configured with 192.168.1.20/24. Connect both PCs to different ports on Switch-01. Configure PC-01 with 192.168.1.10/24, then verify that it can reach PC-02. You do not need a default gateway for this local network.
hints: Each Ethernet port accepts one cable.
Hosts in the same subnet can communicate through a switch without a router.
